info.name: InsureBook — Customer Mobile API
info.description:
All customer-facing mobile APIs for the InsureBook platform.

**Setup:**
1. Set `base_url` collection variable to your server (e.g. `https://your-domain.com`)
2. Call Login and copy the `token` from the response
3. Set `token` collection variable — all protected endpoints auto-use it

**Auth header:** `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`

**Sections:**
1. Authentication
2. Customer — Portfolio & Insurance
3. Settings
4. Investments (Mutual Funds, Fixed Deposits, Other)
5. Taxation (ITR, Tax Planning)
6. Loans (Personal, Home, Mortgage, Business)
7. Travel (Domestic, International)
8. Credit Cards (Rewards, Business, Travel)
9. Common Error Responses
17. Sub-Agent — KYC (Affiliate Onboarding)

request.description: Logs in with a password. `login` accepts an email, mobile number, or PAN card number. `role` is optional (`client` or `sub_agent`); omit it for customer/agent/admin/ambassador accounts, which are resolved automatically from the credentials.

Sends a one-time login OTP to the account's email or mobile number. `login` accepts either an email address or a mobile number. `role` is optional (`client` or `sub_agent`); omit it for customer/agent/admin/ambassador accounts. A new OTP cannot be requested within 30 seconds of the previous one (429 Too Many Requests).

response.name: 200 OK
404 Not Found
429 Too Many Requests

request.description: Verifies the OTP sent via Request OTP and logs the user in. On success, returns the same response shape as the password Login endpoint (JWT token + role-specific profile data). OTPs are single-use, expire after 3 minutes, and lock out after 5 incorrect attempts.

response.name: 401 Expired / Not Found
429 Too Many Attempts

request.description: Registers a new customer (creates both a `Customer` and a `User` record). `role` may be `customer` or `user` (defaults to `customer` if omitted). `first_name`, `last_name`, `email`, `mobile`, `password`, `birth_date`, `nominee_name`, `nominee_relation`, and `nominee_date_of_birth` are required. `nominee_relation` must be one of: father, mother, spouse, son, daughter, brother, sister, other. `gender`, `address`, `city`, `state`, `pincode` are optional.

response.name: 200 OK
409 Conflict
422 Validation Failed

request.description:
Registers a new legacy agent (creates a `User`, not a `SubAgent`). `role` must be `agent`. `first_name`, `last_name`, `email`, `mobile`, and `password` are required; `pan_no`, `address`, `city`, `state`, `gender`, `occupation`, `annual_income` are optional. The account is created inactive and requires admin approval before login.

For self-service affiliate/sub-agent signup with Aadhaar/PAN KYC, use **Register (Affiliate)** below instead.

response.name: 200 OK
409 Conflict
422 Validation Failed

request.description:
Self-service affiliate/sub-agent registration. `role` may be `sub_agent` or `affiliate`. Creates a `SubAgent` (not a `User`) with `status: inactive` and `kyc_status: pending`. `first_name`, `last_name`, `email`, `mobile`, `password` are required; `middle_name`, `pan_no`, `address`, `city`, `state`, `gender`, `birth_date`, `company_name` are optional.

The returned `token` works immediately against the KYC endpoints (see section 16) but not against any other sub-agent endpoint until an admin approves the KYC submission.

response.name: 200 OK
422 Validation Failed

request.description: Looks up the account by `email` or `mobile` across users, customers, and sub-agents. Pass either field — only `email` is shown here.

response.name: 200 OK
200 OK

item.name: 9. Agent — Dashboard & Policies
item.description: Agent/sub-agent dashboard, customer management, and policy creation APIs. Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from a JWT with role `agent` or `sub_agent` — EXCEPT `Insurance Companies` and `Motor Insurance Companies`, which skip auth entirely (public lookup endpoints).

request.description: Agent/sub-agent dashboard summary: profile info, top-line stats, and recent activity feed.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Paginated list of customers visible to the agent/sub-agent, with policy counts and premium totals. `filter` accepts `all` (default), `agent_added`, or `system_added`.

Agent-created customer. `first_name`, `mobile`, `email` are required. If `password`/`password_confirmation` are omitted, a secure password is auto-generated and returned in `password_info`. NOTE: unlike most mobile endpoints this responds with a `status` boolean key rather than `success`.

response.name: 201 Created
409 Duplicate Customer
422 Validation Failed

request.description: All policies (health/life/motor/other) belonging to the agent/sub-agent, merged and sorted by creation date. Omit `page`/`per_page` to get the full unpaginated list. `policy_type` filters to `health`, `life`, `motor`, `other`, or `all`.

Creates a health insurance policy for a customer. `client_id`, `policy_holder`, `insurance_company_id`, `plan_name`, `policy_number`, `net_premium` are required. Accepts nested `family_members` and `documents` arrays. NOTE: responds with `status` boolean key, not `success`.

Creates a life insurance policy. `client_id`, `policy_holder`, `insured_name`, `insurance_company_id`, `policy_number`, `policy_start_date`, `policy_end_date`, `policy_term_years`, `premium_payment_term_years`, `net_premium` are required. Accepts nested `nominees`, `bank_details`, and `documents`. NOTE: responds with `status` boolean key, not `success`.

response.name: 422 Validation Failed

request.description: Creates a motor insurance policy. `customer_id` is required (customer must already exist). Accepts vehicle details and a nested `documents` array.

item.description: Commission payout breakdown/summary/history/stats. Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` for a `sub_agent` or `agent` (`User`) JWT. Every action here is also reachable under `agent/commission/*` (e.g. `agent/commission/breakdown`) — same controller action, aliased route, identical response.

Month-by-month commission stats for the current calendar year, plus year-to-date totals. Alias: `agent/commission/stats`.

request.description:
Uploads Aadhaar and/or PAN card photos for the currently authenticated sub-agent (token from Register (Affiliate) or sub-agent Login). Each file is stored on R2 and run through OCR synchronously (Google Cloud Vision - TEXT_DETECTION). Once both an Aadhaar Card and a Pancard document exist, `kyc_status` moves to `submitted` and a confirmation email is sent.

Each returned document includes `name`, `dob`, and `id_number` flattened to the top level for convenience (pulled from `ocr_extracted_data`), plus the full `ocr_text` Vision read off the card and the complete `ocr_extracted_data` (also has `gender`/`address` for Aadhaar, `father_name` for PAN, when present). These are best-effort - number/DOB/gender match fixed formats and are reliable; name/address are inferred from label text and are lower-confidence, so the mobile app should treat them as pre-fill, not ground truth, until the admin approves.

Send just `aadhaar_file` or just `pan_file` to fill in a missing document, or to resend after a rejection - this clears `kyc_rejection_reason` and re-submits once both are present.

This endpoint (and Check KYC Status) works even while the account is `inactive` / KYC is pending or rejected - unlike every other sub-agent endpoint, which requires an approved, active account.
